notes.first_second: Device + screen are on-frame at t=0 and never rebuilt. The in-phone camera (.screen-world) opens at scale 1.05 and settles to 1.00 by 0.55s on power3.out — it enters already travelling inward, so a cut from frame 15 lands mid-push rather than on a dead frame. The stage title cascade ignites at 0.15s; the deals list is still empty at 1.0s.
notes.last_second: Camera is in a linear (ease:none) creep from scale 1.16 to 1.22 running 10.90s → 12.00s and is therefore STILL MOVING on the final frame — no settle, no fade. Framing at 12.00s is centred between the deals list and the curation card; the final reveal (info body line B) completes at 10.95s, so the last second is a moving hold.

exit.vector: push-in (+Z) at ~47 px/s of screen-edge expansion (scale 1.16→1.22, linear), with ~6 px/s downward drift of the framing point

entry.vector: push-in (+Z) at ~230 px/s of screen-edge contraction (scale 1.05→1.00, power3.out over 0.55s)
